name: Payton Talbott
summary: A long, rangy, high-output striker from Reno with slick lines of attack; his one loss (Raoni Barcelos) came when he was wrestled and made to work. Coming off a clear win over Henry Cejudo.

how_they_fight.Striking: Tall for bantamweight with the length to keep opponents on the end of his punches. Lands about 5.9 significant strikes a minute; flowing combinations and unorthodox angles, with finishing power (two first- and second-round KOs in 2024).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Defensive grappling has improved since the Barcelos loss; he beat Cejudo, an Olympic champion wrestler, over three rounds.
how_they_fight.Defense: Stops about 72% of takedowns. Can be hit while he's attacking.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Keeps a high pace for three rounds; ten-month layoff since December.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Confident, creative; handles veteran pressure better than a year ago.

concerns: Can be taken down by strong wrestlers

news.text: A heavy betting favorite (around -575 to -650) over Figueiredo.
